outcome: Identification of proteins derived from and taken up by the placenta
Longitudinal patterns of placenta-derived proteins across gestation
Identification of placenta-derived proteins as reference curves for placental function
cohort: Two cohorts: 70 healthy pregnancies in the longitudinal STORK cohort (samples at gestational weeks 14-16, 22-24, and 30-32), and 75 healthy pregnancies in the cross-sectional 4-vessel cohort (samples from maternal antecubital vein, radial artery, and uterine vein during cesarean section)
finding: The study identified 256 placenta-derived proteins and 101 proteins taken up by the placenta in maternal circulation, with distinct developmental patterns across gestation, and proposed a 'placental proteomic clock' based on five proteins that closely tracked gestational age.
